title: A production path for shared, governed category decisions
scope: One internal retail organisation; scheduled batch refresh; authenticated browser access; a shared review-plan API. Service choice and capacity require customer validation.
today: The shipped prototype is a deterministic Python pipeline and standalone HTML. Plans are stored in this browser. There is no hosted API, sign-in, shared database, ERP write-back or Azure deployment.
flow: Land retailer exports in a private raw Blob container, using an agreed ingestion contract and workload identity.
Run the containerised analysis on an agreed UTC schedule with Azure Container Apps Jobs. Validate inputs before publication and use snapshot IDs to make retries idempotent.
Publish complete, versioned evidence and review artifacts to a private review container. On failure, retain the last successful snapshot and show a stale-data warning; alert the operator.
Serve the dashboard and authorised evidence through a Python API on Azure App Service. Microsoft Entra ID signs users in; the API must enforce app roles and retailer/category scope on every request.
Replace browser-only plan storage with PostgreSQL-backed plans, version checks, audit events and evidence-snapshot references. Browser storage may remain only an explicitly labelled draft cache.

services.name: Azure App Service
services.purpose: Host the dashboard and a new Python API together, with built-in Entra authentication.
services.change_needed: Implement API endpoints, tenant/category authorisation, anti-CSRF protection for cookie-authenticated writes, concurrency control and controlled evidence downloads.

services.name: Azure Container Apps Jobs
services.purpose: Run the existing deterministic analysis as a finite, scheduled batch workload.
services.change_needed: Package the Python job and input/output adapters, configure schedule/retries/timeouts, and publish only fully validated snapshots.

services.name: Azure Blob Storage
services.purpose: Store raw inputs and versioned review artifacts in separate private containers of a storage account.
services.change_needed: Define retention, versioning, encryption/access policies and an atomic current-successful-review pointer. Do not expose raw or review containers anonymously.

services.name: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
services.purpose: Persist shared action plans, owners, due dates, decisions, row versions and audit history.
services.change_needed: Create a scoped schema and least-privilege application role; configure Entra-based managed-identity access, backups and a tested restore process.

services.name: Microsoft Entra ID and managed identities
services.purpose: Separate user sign-in from service-to-service access without hardcoded cloud credentials.
services.change_needed: Configure app roles and identity lifecycle. Grant the job Blob read/write permissions and the API only the Blob/database permissions it needs; authentication alone is not business authorisation.

services.name: Azure Monitor, Application Insights and Log Analytics
services.purpose: Make failed refreshes, validation errors, stale snapshots and API health visible to an accountable operator.
services.change_needed: Instrument the new API and job, correlate logs with snapshot IDs, set retention/alerts and avoid sending raw commercial data or user notes to telemetry.

services.name: Azure Container Registry and GitHub Actions
services.purpose: Version the analysis image and deploy tested releases through workload identity federation (OIDC).
services.change_needed: Create CI build/deploy stages and environment approval gates; pin released image digests. This does not imply a production deployment workflow exists today.

services.name: Azure Key Vault - only if required
services.purpose: Store external-source credentials that cannot use federated or managed identity.
services.change_needed: Use managed identity to retrieve only required secrets. Omit this service if all connections can be passwordless.

controls: Private data tier: App Service VNet integration, a VNet-integrated Container Apps environment, private Blob endpoints and private PostgreSQL connectivity with private DNS. Network access paths and subnet capacity must be designed before deployment.
Authenticated HTTPS application ingress, with access restricted to the agreed workforce audience. A WAF or fully private ingress can be added if the customer's security standard requires it.
Separate managed identities and least-privilege data-plane permissions for the API and batch job; enforce app roles and category/retailer scope in API code.
Immutable logical review versions, evidence-linked decisions, optimistic concurrency, explicit retention and audit policies, and tested backup/restore.
Human approval remains mandatory before any replenishment, pricing or range change. This design does not write to operational retail systems.
rollout: Agree source contracts, ownership, data classification, review cadence, success metrics, RPO/RTO and an Azure region with the customer.
Build the authenticated API/shared-plan schema and batch adapters; test authorisation, simultaneous edits, failed refreshes and restored backups.
Pilot one category with a small user group and measure decision follow-through and commercial outcomes before expanding.
not_required: No Azure OpenAI/Foundry runtime, vector database, AKS cluster, event bus or data lake platform is needed for this batch rules-based scope. No costs, capacities or production SLAs are asserted without workload requirements.
